algorithm: Red policy: local maxima strictly above max(layer Q99 upper histogram-bin edge, median+1/(8*5) per cell). 4-connected 2D background flood fill excludes crop-boundary-connected regions. Blue = adjacent material-side cell of every enclosed gap. Curvature = nonnegative circumcircle curvature at +/-5 unit contour edges, averaged across +/-2 neighbouring contour edges to reduce digital-staircase fluctuations; loops <24 edges are unresolved. Red candidates are local +/-2-edge maxima under the explicitly selected policy. Quantiles and median/MAD use a declared 4096-bin histogram over [0,2] per grid cell. Fisher excess kurtosis uses all resolved curvature samples and is not curvature or a significance level. Individual loops >1048576 edges retain all blue contours but skip curvature to bound RAM. Geometric candidates only; no stress, biological diagnosis, calibrated p-value, or new acquired resolution.
